records.label: Overview
notes: Kingdom trajectories are uncommitted causal pressures. No later battle, death, promotion, marriage, alliance, betrayal, unit formation, office, or conquest has been imported as completed fact.

House Tang is a wealthy common-born private military-economic household whose reputation comes from escort work, protection, caravan recovery, internal production, discipline, and refusal to sell its equipment or doctrine. It did not build its reputation through previous Qin service.
